disclaimer: Synthetic embedding geometry, not a face model. See scripts/bench/synthetic.ts and docs/BENCHMARKS.md. No face-recognition model in this repository is licensed for production use.

regimes.name: weak
regimes.note: Poor separation. Stands in for a small/quantised model, or a very hostile room.

regimes.name: moderate
regimes.note: Genuine and impostor distributions still overlap in the tails.

regimes.name: strong
regimes.note: Roughly where a well-behaved ArcFace-family model on cooperative images sits.

regimes.name: excellent
regimes.note: Near-ideal. Included to show which failures do NOT go away with a better model.
